$comment: Accepted dependency advisories for the gate 11 audit (infra/security/src/audit.ts). Each entry names the advisory, the package it was accepted for, why, and the date by which it is reviewed again; an entry past its review_by date fails the audit until someone reviews it and moves the date. Remove an entry once the advisory no longer appears. The audit fails on any production advisory and on any critical advisory anywhere in the tree (malware advisories are critical).

advisories.reason: No patched release exists (vulnerable <=1.4.0). It comes with the Expo command line tool that builds and serves Compass; the Compass app bundle does not include @expo/cli. Accepted 2026-10-19 (A54, gate 11).

The fix, 0.5.0, is ESM only, and query-string 7 under expo-router requires it from CommonJS, so it cannot be applied as an override. The worst case is a stalled Compass screen on the device that opens a malformed link (denial of service, no data exposure). Review when expo-router moves to a query-string that accepts 0.5.0. Accepted 2026-10-19 (A54, gate 11).

Reached only by build and test tooling, never by an app, Edge Function or Compass bundle: production scope through packages/config's stylelint 16.26.1 (and stylelint-use-logical-spec) > ajv 8.20.0 > fast-uri, which @xos/canon-import also reaches through @xos/config; development scope through ajv-formats 2.1.1 in @xos/config and ajv, ajv-formats 3.0.1 and ajv-draft-04 in @xos/api. ajv parses only the URIs in the repository's own JSON schemas, and the only direct import of ajv is a test (packages/schemas/test/automations). The patched 3.1.9 was published 2026-10-19 23:05 UTC and becomes eligible under ADR 0001's two-week rule on 2026-11-03; then add the override fast-uri@>=3.0.0 <3.1.9 to 3.1.9 in pnpm-workspace.yaml and remove this entry (RRR-242). Accepted 2026-10-24; reviewed 2026-10-28 (paths rechecked with pnpm why, review moved one week past eligibility).

zod 3.25.76 comes only with the Expo command line tool that builds and serves Compass; the Compass app bundle does not include @expo/cli, and 3.x has no patched release. Every shipped package pins zod 4.6.6, the fixed release; the versions field keeps this entry from covering any 4.x. Review when expo moves @expo/cli to zod 4. Accepted 2026-10-24.

No patched release exists (vulnerable >=4.2.0 <=4.3.1). html-to-text uses deepmerge only to combine its option objects (html-to-text.cjs: the defaults with the caller's options, and duplicate selector entries); the email HTML is parsed, never merged. Our one caller, packages/email/src/render.ts, renders plain text with fixed options ({ plainText: true }), so no attacker-controlled object reaches mergeObject(). Review when html-to-text or deepmerge ships a fix. Accepted 2026-10-28 (RRR-241, gate 11).

Every release up to 0.5.0 is vulnerable, and the fix, 0.5.1 (published 2026-10-23), is ESM only like 0.5.0, so query-string 7 under expo-router, which requires it from CommonJS, cannot take it as an override; 0.5.1 is also short of ADR 0001's two-week rule. pnpm why finds this one path only, in the Compass app, so no web app, Edge Function or API reaches it. The worst case is a stalled Compass screen on the device that opens a deliberately malformed link (quadratic decoding, denial of service, no data exposure), as for GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr. Review with that entry when expo-router moves to a query-string that accepts 0.5.x. Accepted 2026-10-30 (RRR-243, gate 11).
